entry.title: Entry #1651 in The New York Times Company v. Microsoft Corporation, 1:23-cv-11195
entry.summary: AMENDED STIPULATED OMNIBUS SEALING ORDER FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT AND DAUBERT BRIEFING: IT IS HEREBY ORDERED that sealing issues relating to summary judgment and Daubert briefing will be handled as follows: 1. The Parties may provisionally seal portions of briefing and exhibits (including expert reports and declarations) relating to Daubert briefing that contain or refer to material produced in this case that is designated Protected Discovery Material. 2. The Parties may provisionally seal exhibits ( or portions thereof) relating to summary judgment briefing (including expert reports and declarations) that contain or refer to material produced in this case that is designated Protected Discovery Material.7. Any response to any omnibus motion to seal shall be filed by January 20, 2027.8. By January 27, 2027, the Parties must publicly file any Provisionally SealedMaterial that no Party or third party moved to seal by January 13, 2027. 10. Nothing herein prevents any Party from challenging another Party's or third party's request to maintain certain material under seal. (And as further set forth herein.) IT IS ORDERED that the forgoing is approved. (Signed by Judge Sidney H. Stein on 10/13/2026) Filed In Associated Cases: 1:25-md-03143-SHS-OTW et al. (jca) (Entered: 10/14/2026)
